arxiv-1706-03686.title: Image Crowd Counting Using Convolutional Neural Network and Markov Random Field
arxiv-1706-03686.creator: Kang Han, Wanggen Wan, Haiyan Yao, and Li Hou
arxiv-1706-03686.description: A 2017 arXiv research paper by Kang Han, Wanggen Wan, Haiyan Yao, and Li Hou. In this paper, we propose a method called Convolutional Neural Network-Markov Random Field (CNN-MRF) to estimate the crowd count in a still image. We first divide the dense crowd visible image into overlapping patches and then use a deep convolutional neural network to extract features from each patch image, followed by a fully connected neural network to regress the local patch crowd count.

arxiv-2109-03615.title: Tactile Image-to-Image Disentanglement of Contact Geometry from Motion-Induced Shear
arxiv-2109-03615.creator: Anupam K. Gupta
arxiv-2109-03615.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Anupam K. Gupta. Robotic touch, particularly when using soft optical tactile sensors, suffers from distortion caused by motion-dependent shear. The manner in which the sensor contacts a stimulus is entangled with the tactile information about the geometry of the stimulus. In this work, we propose a supervised convolutional deep neural network model that learns to disentangle, in the latent space, the components of sensor deformations caused by contact geometry from those due to sliding-induced shear.

arxiv-2501-07211.title: Tensor decomposition technique for qubit encoding of maximal-fidelity Lorentzian orbitals in real-space quantum chemistry
arxiv-2501-07211.creator: Taichi Kosugi, Xinchi Huang, Hirofumi Nishi, Yu-ichiro Matsushita
arxiv-2501-07211.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Taichi Kosugi, Xinchi Huang, Hirofumi Nishi, Yu-ichiro Matsushita. To simulate the real- and imaginary-time evolution of a many-electron system on a quantum computer based on the first-quantized formalism, we need to encode molecular orbitals (MOs) into qubit states for typical initial-state preparation. We propose an efficient scheme for encoding an MO as a many-qubit state from a Gaussian-type solution that can be obtained from a tractable solver on a classical computer.

pmc-10694015.creator: Kaibo Sun, Yue Ming, Jiawen Xu, Yuangang Wu, Yi Zeng, Limin Wu, Mingyang Li, Bin Shen

pmc-11316352.title: Uncovering the genomic basis of symbiotic interactions and niche adaptations in freshwater picocyanobacteria
pmc-11316352.creator: Hongjae Park, Paul‑Adrian Bulzu, Tanja Shabarova, Vinicius S Kavagutti, Rohit Ghai, Vojtěch Kasalický, Jitka Jezberová
pmc-11316352.description: BackgroundPicocyanobacteria from the genera Prochlorococcus, Synechococcus, and Cyanobium are the most widespread photosynthetic organisms in aquatic ecosystems. pmc-11388733.title: Comparison and classification of photovoltaic system architectures for limiting the impact of the partial shading phenomenon
pmc-11388733.creator: Luc Vivien Assiene Mouodo, AbdeL-Hamid Mahamat Ali, Sosso Mayi Olivier Thierry, Alvine Donfang Moteyo, Jean Gaston Tamba, Petros Axaopoulos
pmc-11388733.description: This article proposes a comparison and classification of PV system architectures with the aim of limiting the impact of the partial shading phenomenon which remains one of the most harmful defects during the production of electrical energy with significant consequences on output power, current and voltage.

pmc-11421346.title: Superficial palmar arch aneurysm secondary to blunt trauma: Bag of ice versus bare hand!
pmc-11421346.creator: Michael Ramdass, Megan Augustus, Keagan Dos Santos, Richard Spence, Chanelle Skeete, Adedapo Oladiran, Adrian Brahim
pmc-11421346.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). A 45-year-old male prisoner was referred to the orthopedic outpatients clinic after he sustained a blunt palmar injury when he tried to break-up a bag of ice with the volar aspect of his hand. A few months later a pulsatile expansile mass developed at the site of blunt trauma affecting flexion and extension of the fingers and inability to hold objects. A computed tomography angiogram confirmed the mass to be a true aneurysm of the superficial palmar arch 3 cm in size.

pmc-11638337.title: Characterisation of the genetic diversity of citrus viroid VII using amplicon sequencing
pmc-11638337.creator: Grant A Chambers, Andrew DW Geering, Daniel R Bogema, Paul Holford, Georgios Vidalakis, Nerida J Donovan
pmc-11638337.description: Viroids occur in plants as swarms of sequence variants clustered around a dominant variant, leading to adoption of the term ‘quasispecies’ to describe the viroid population in an individual host. The composition of the quasispecies can potentially change according to the age of the infection, the position of the leaf or branch in the canopy, and the host species.

pmc-11674799.title: Proteomics: An Essential Tool to Study Plant-Specialized Metabolism
pmc-11674799.creator: María José Martínez-Esteso, Jaime Morante-Carriel, Antonio Samper-Herrero, Ascensión Martínez-Márquez, Susana Sellés-Marchart, Hugo Nájera, Roque Bru-Martínez
pmc-11674799.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Plants are a valuable source of specialized metabolites that provide a plethora of therapeutic applications. They are natural defenses that plants use to adapt and respond to their changing environment. Decoding their biosynthetic pathways and understanding how specialized plant metabolites (SPMs) respond to biotic or abiotic stress will provide vital knowledge for plant biology research and its application for the future sustainable production of many SPMs of interest.

pmc-12718252.title: Haloferax mediterranei R4 for bioremediation of desalination and textile wastes: a step towards their valorisation
pmc-12718252.creator: Iraide Sáez-Zamacona, Rosa María Martínez-Espinosa, Guillermo Grindlay
pmc-12718252.description: Haloferax mediterranei has shown strong potential for bioremediating brines contaminated with nitrogenous compounds, oxychlorides, and metals, making it a promising candidate for treating saline wastewater. Therefore, this study aims to evaluate its capacity to bioremediate industrial wastewaters (IWWs) from desalination and textile industries.

pmc-12993880.title: Prompting large language models and evaluating inter- and intra-rater agreement for cancer progression assessment from radiology reports
pmc-12993880.creator: TÓ Kristjánsson, AF Henriksen, ML Hansen, DG Kovacs, A Bjerrum
pmc-12993880.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundManual annotation of free-text radiology reports is time-consuming and costly, delaying real-world evidence (RWE) studies in oncology. This study aimed to evaluate the performance of large language models (LLMs) in annotating cancer progression from Danish free-text radiology reports.

pmc-13299763.title: Melanin Deficiency Is Associated with Immune Homeostasis in the Critically Endangered Yangtze Sturgeon (Acipenser dabryanus)
pmc-13299763.creator: Bin Wang, Yingzi Li, Han Sun, Fei Yang, Kezhen Jiang, Ya Li, Yixiao Xiong, Zhaoxiong Yu, Xueling Zhang, Peiqi Lv, Zhongliang Zhang, Xin Zhang, Zhiqiong Li, Bo Zhou, Ni Tang
pmc-13299763.description: The Yangtze sturgeon (Acipenser dabryanus), a critically endangered living fossil whose wild populations are now extinct, faces new challenges to survival in captive breeding. Among these, the emergence of albino and gray color morphs raise fundamental questions about the molecular basis and physiological consequences of pigmentation loss.
